items.author: Haustorium12
items.body:
## The Problem

Claude Code has no persistent memory between context compactions. Every time the context window fills up and compacts, the instance loses everything that wasn't externally saved. After 59 documented compactions across 26 days of daily use, I built a complete memory persistence system from scratch because one didn't exist.

This isn't a feature request from someone who used Claude Code once. This is field data from someone who runs it 12-18 hours a day across two machines (home PC and work PC with a portable drive), managing 6 active projects, 31 intelligence scouts, and a multi
items.title: Feature Request: Persistent Memory Across Context Compactions (59 compactions, built our own)
